entries.name: Location: Succubus Cafe
entries.content:
The Succubus Cafe is a minor location within the city of Axel that is run by Succubi.
##Overview: Although they are monsters, adventurers and succubi posses a mutual beneficial relationship in Axel. Since the male adventurers live in stables, alongside other adventurers, they can't have any interpersonal relationship there, so the succubi give men pleasant dreams in exchange of a bit of Vitality.

For this reason, the succubi established a Fortune Cafe in Axel. During the day, the Cafe poses as a regular restaurant, where waitresses in lachivous outfits (the succubi outfit) will serve food. However, at night, men can fill out a form detailing what kind of sexual experience they would like in their dreams. The cafe staff will send one of their own to the location given and, in a quid pro quo, take a small amount of Vitality in exchange for giving the customer the request from their form.

The Cafe true nature is a secret between the men in Axel, as well is the reason why many veteran adventurers remained in Axel, as well as is the main reason why the male adventurers are so willing to protect the town. It is also the reason why most adventurers don't date women in Axel.

entries.name: Species: Succubus
entries.content:
Succubi are dream demons who feed on men's vitality.
##Appearance: Succubi look like beautiful women with a body all men would dream about, in order to seduce them, with a mature and voluptuous look (although one succubus in Axel looks like a young and underdeveloped girl). They usually wear sexy lingeries, however Succubi also wear regular clothes in order to remain incognito in the city.

Being demons, they have bat-like wings and arrow-tip shaped tails that they can hide in order to remain incognito. 

##Overview: Succubi are low-ranked demons specialized in absorbing the lust of men, by giving them all types of erotic dream. However, since men are necessary for their survival, they aren't a dangerous type of monster, as succubi prefer to sell their services to men, in exchange of vitality and protection, or creating a nausty, but harmless, dungeon like the Labyrinth of Desire in the Royal Capital.

However, succubi are the enemy of women, as they both compete for the men's attention, and the last sometimes choose a business relationship with a succubus over dating actual women. 

##Variations:
#Incubus: Male dream demons who feed on women's vitality. They usually wear a gothic outfit.
#Succubus Queen: If a powerful succubus, who experienced both hope and deception, puts a drop of her blood in a magical candle, she will become a demon powerful enough to destroy a whole city.

##Abilities: Succubi are low-ranked demons who feed on men's vitality and use their strength to fight.
#Charm: Seduces the target, putting them under the user's control. It does not work against the undead.
#Dreams: Controls with what the target dreams about. It's done by touching their forehead and casting the spell.
#Flight: Succubi have the ability to fly in the sky using bat-like wings.
#Intermediate Magic: As low-ranked demons, succubi can use mind-affecting intermediate spells.
#Paralyze: Makes a person unable to move.
#Sleep: A curse that puts the target to sleep without them notice.
#Bat Tamer: Some rare succubi can communicate and control bat-type monsters.

##Trivia:
#The Charm skill is usually used by succubi to charm women and to fight.
#Succubi and Tranquility Girls don't get along well, since they both charm men.
#Succubi and Incubi don't get along well too, since they steal each other's clients sometimes.

entries.name: Monster: Tranquility Girl
entries.content:
Tranquility Girls are plant monsters that take the form of adorable girls to lure their prey.

##Appearance: Tranquility Girls take the form of a helpless little girl, in some cases seemingly injured, with trees bearing their fruits growing not far from them. 

##Personality: While they look innocent, Tranquility Girls are two-faced monsters that make their killers feel bad whatever they slay the Tranquility Girl or not. They are insidious, often using any dirty trick to manipulate their victims and slayers, also destroying their executioner's morale by telling harsh truths when the Tranquility Girl are on the verge of death. They are ruthless since their birth.

##Overview: Tranquility Girls are sentient plants categorised as an offshoot of Alraunes. They takes the form of a little and injuried girl in order to fool travelers into staying by their side and protect them, while letting their victims feed on its fruits, those are addictive and entirely devoid of nutritional value, until their protectors die of malnutrition, at which point the Tranquility Girl's roots will take and consume their corpses as fertiliser.

Tranquility Girls are so named because many dying elderly adventurers actively seek them out in order to die a peaceful, tranquil death. In areas where they inhabit, general warnings are given to woodcutters and adventurers to exterminate them on sight. 

##Variations: 
#Tranquility Queen: Bigger and more mature versions of the regular girl that are born once in a century and with a root system extensive enough to cover a whole forest. They try to form a bond with their victims instead of evoking their protective instincts.

##Abilities:
#Charm: Enchants the target, putting them under the user's control.
#Roots: Once the Tranquility Girl's victim dies, her roots grab and dig their corpse.

##Trivia:
#Kazuma is immune to there charm and doesn't fall for there tricks
#Tranquility Girls usually ask travelers to move their offspring to somewhere safe once they are born.
#Tranquility Girls photosynthesize through weeds that grow around her.
#A Tranquility Girls' arch nemesis are herbivores.

entries.name: Monster: Demon
entries.content:
Demons are a tribe from Hell that oppose the gods, and live by feeding on people's emotions.

##Appearance:
The appearances of demons vary, some looking like abominable, horrifying and even "stomach-turning" monsters. Others may appear to be regular human beings, albeit with demonic traits including horns, pointed tails, and bat-like wings. A demon can even look like a regular object, such as a theater mask.

According to a demon called Amaryllis, demons can choose and change their own appearance.

##Overview: Demons are strictly-speaking genderless creatures, despite some of them taking on distinct male or female appearances and personalities. Demons also gain "extra lives" by performing bad deeds, so they can return to the living world by sacrificing part of their souls, although it can take some years.[4] Powerful demons are also able to manifest only part of themselves in the living world through certain mediums while leaving the remainder in the safety of Hell, as well as having the capability to use magic or other demonic abilities.

While some low-ranking demons and their variations may need to sustain themselves with material food, the majority of them can live practically forever if provided with certain types of negative emotions from sentient living creatures. Weaker demons on the verge of losing their final life can also get their lives blown back into them by the demonic powers of stronger demons.

Despite their power and immortality, Demons can be harmed by holy water, silver and the divine power of priests, and while they are resistant againt regular magic, Demons are vulnerable to evil-dispeling magic. The holy aura of churches and deities as well as the aftermath of powerful holy magic can also interfere with their demonic abilities.

##Culture: The demonic culture is highly centralised on the concept of contracts, something which demons value above their lives, and will rather die attempting to hold their end of the bargain than go back on it, while also respecting the contracts entered into by other demons. This professionalism has made them a popular subject of summoning by various clients both human or otherwise, as long as the price to pay is worth it, though recently the demons started becoming tired of humans always trying to think of excuses to shirk from making their payment.

Their culture is also based on the survive of the fittest, as they usually have to survive all by themselves without protection from outsiders.

##Hierarchy: Demons and their variations are categorized into an assortment of ranks depending on their power. Low-Ranked Demons can be defeated by regular adventurers, while the High-Ranked ones require many Arch Wizards or an Arch Priest to vanquish: 
#Archdemon: Duke of Hell, The top-tier rulers of Hell, they wield powers rivaling those of the gods themselves. 
#High-Ranked Demon
#Mid-Ranked Demon
#Low-Ranked Demon:
Succubus
Gremlin: Feral demons that prowl the depths of dungeons where the air is thick with magic.
Nightmare: Demonic horses said to cause bad dreams.
Gargoyle: Demons looking like statues that possess bodies of various compositions.
Servants of the Dark God: Generic demons covered in fur.
Black Hound: Demonic hounds of Hell that herald doom and misfortune.
Cerberus: Three-headed guard dogs of Hell.
Incubus: Demons with the appearance of playboys, who sustain themselves by draining the vitality of women they seduce.
Bleeding Spider: A pillow-sized spider demon that wraps its prey and torments them in order to extract their ill feelings, without eating them.
#Other: 
Oni: Demonic creatures that are ranked so low they aren't even considered proper demons in the hierarchy.

##Trivia:
Demons don't date humans because, due to the age gap,
It is problematic for demons to say their real name to mortals.
Demons raises their spirit at full moon.
Demons possess the purest and highest-quality mana.
Like the gods, demons have humans who worship them, the Demon Summoners. They can also change class to become actual demons

entries.name: Monster: Dragon
entries.content:
Dragons are the most powerful type of monster.
##Appearance: Dragons generally look like huge reptiles covered in thick scales of various colours, sport large teeth and claws, and grow horns on their heads as well as webbed wings on their backs. Some of them though have the ability to transform into a human form.
##Overview: Dragons do not only possess incredible strength and astonishing endurance to physical and magical attacks, but are also high Intelligence stats. Since they are the embodiment of Magical Power, their horns, scales, fangs and even their blood are valuable materials, and Dragons also have enough mana in their bodies to damage even a Lich. They, however, possess a weak spot right on their back, as a inverse scale, that grows upside down.

While Dragons are known for eating unusual things, like gold, to collect shiny items and end up hoarding a lot of treasure, they are also able to trade and understand human speech and even make deals with humans, as seen in their partnerships with Dragon Knights. However, on their society, the strong eats the weak, so they usually just listen the strongest ones. 

##Classification: Being creatures with a lifespan of many centuries, Dragons are classed by their age
#Lesser Dragon: Dragons of less than one hundred years-old.
#Greater Dragon: Centenarian Dragons that are not only more powerful, but as smart as humans and also able to understand human speech.
#Ancient/Elder Dragon: The eldest and most powerful type of Dragon, who awakened an ego and became able to assume a human form.

##Variations:
#Red Dragon: Dragons with red scales and fire attribute.
#Green Dragon: Dragons with green scales, they have wind attribute.
#Zombie Dragon: Dead Dragons covered in rotting flesh that turn into Undeads, and despite only vomiting if they try to use breath, their strength and endurance are much higher.
#Golden Dragon: Dragons with electric attribute and gold scales from all the gold ore they ingest, and are considered the most valuable type of their species.
#White Dragon: Dragons with pure white bodies that can use holy magic, and are on the verge of hunted to extinction because their bones and fangs are said to bring good luck.
#Black Dragon: Dragons with pitch-black bodies and dark attribute.
#Sea Dragon: Northern sea storms dragons with water attribute.

##Abilities:
Flight: Dragons are able to fly in the sky using the wings on their backs.
Resistance: Dragons have extremely hard scales, resistant against both magical and physical attacks.
Breath: Dragons can breath out elemental power, as fire or water.

##Trivia:
#Once they are named, Dragons will never respond to any other name as long as they live,
#Dragon Eggs cost hundreds of millions Eris.
#Those who have killed Dragons are given the title "Dragon Slayer", though it doesn't apply to those who kill weak and/or baby dragons.
#The longer dragon's parent incubates the egg, the more magical power and parental traits they will develop. They warm their eggs with magic power so their offspring born with powerful magic power themselves.
#Although eating Dragons will grant someone great strength and experience, as a carnivorous animal, their meat is really tough and taste terrible. It, however, becomes tender after boiled in an alchemy pot for a very long time.
#Monsters like Wyverns, Kowloon Hydras, and Leviathans are classed as Lesser Dragon subspecies.
#According to Aqua, dragons enjoy to drink alcohol.

entries.name: Monster: Wyvern
entries.content:
Wyverns are a type of flying reptile and a dragon subspecies.

##Appearance: Wyverns look like bipedal dragons with webbed wings on their forearms, spines over their backs and a stinger on their tails. They generally have whitish abdomens while the scales on the rest of their bodies have various coloration, and strong breeds may grown horns on their foreheads. 

##Overview: Wyverns are carnivorous reptilian creatures that are part of the Dragon family and, although they aren't as strong as true dragons, they still are a threat to the mankind. Wyverns sometimes get targeted by adventurers trying to earn the title of "Dragon Slayer" through less effort.

##Variations: Great Wyvern, Large Wyverns that sport a longer horn.

##Abilities:
Flight: Wyverns are able to fly using the webbed wings they grow on their forearms.
Paralysis: Wyverns have a sting on the end of their tails, which produces a powerful paralytic venom.

entries.name: Monster: Lovely Rabbit
entries.content:
Lovely Rabbits are cute-looking but aggressive rabbits.
##Appearance: Lovely Rabbits look like cute rabbits with a horn growing out of their foreheads. 

##Overview: Lovely Rabbits, despite their cute and docile appearance, are actually carnivorous and will lunge at people to impale them with their horns.

##Variations:
#Deadly Bunny: Lovely Rabbits that grow larger than most.
#Lovely White Rabbit: Lovely Rabbits inhabiting snowy environments that grow a spiny horn.
#Combination Lovely Rabbit: Lovely Rabbits with grey fur that grow multiple horns.
#Death Rabbit: Lovely Rabbits with black fur that grow a sickle blade in place of a horn.

entries.name: Monster: Leviathan
entries.content:
Leviathans are gigantic sea creatures.
##Appearance: Leviathan's offsprings looks like eels or sea serpents, later growing legs. They are so big they wouldn't fit in a lake.
##Overview: Creatures closer to spirits than monsters, they are a dragon-type monster highly intelligent and docile, that only attacks in self-defense. They usually lay many eggs, and their offsprings follow sea rains and grow-up fast. Also, as a dragon-type monster, they also enjoy alcohol.

##Abilities: Leviathan are intelligent creatures able to learn magic, and, as a dragon-type monster, they are extremely powerful.
#Resistance: The leviathan scales are highly resistant.
#Breath (Water): The skill to breathe out an elemental power. Leviathans breath water.

entries.name: Species: Lich
entries.content:
Liches are High-Ranked Undead, also known as the "No Life King." They usually were powerful Arch Wizards who became even more powerful after becoming a Lich.

##Appearance: Liches usually look like Skeletons, although Liches who kept eattng or are recently-transformed keep their human appearance.

##Overview: Once Arch Wizards who had mastered the limits of magic, Liches have abandoned their natural bodies through arcane rituals, becoming Kings of the Undead. While most Liches used to be human, it is also possible for other races to become Liches.

Despite their power and immortality, Liches can be harmed by holy water and the Holy Magic of priests, being vulnerable to powerful Purification Magic.

##Abilities:
#Hand of the Immortal King: Gives random debuffs on target with a physical touch or attacks with hostile intent. These include Level Drain, Curse, Sleep, Magic Seal, Panic, Petrification, and Instant Death.
#Drain Touch: Absorbs MP and HP from a target, which in turn can be transferred to somebody else.
#Physical Resistance: Only physical attacks from magic weapons can damage Liches.
#Magic Resistance: Liches have high resistance against magical attacks.
#Necromancy: Liches can command the ghosts and reanimate deceased creatures to serve as allies.

##Notable Liches:
#Wiz
#Keele
#Unnamed Lich who researched monster creation in the Depths of the Goblin Cave.
#Duke

##Trivia:
#Liches' hair and nails are valuable magic items since they are full of Magical Power.
#Liches have a rivalry with Vampires over who are the Kings of Undead.
#Wiz didn’t become a skeleton after she became a Lich because she kept eating, suggesting that Liches can retain their flesh that way.
#Liches are the only undead who can cast magic alongside Vampires and Wight Kings.

entries.name: Monster: Lizard Runner
entries.content:
Lizard Runners are fast-running lizards that like to compete on speed.

##Appearance: The majority of Lizard Runners, which are composed of males, look like human-sized bipedal purple frill-necked lizards. The rare female, known as the Princess Runner, is a size bigger and coloured brownish-red.

##Overview: Lizard Runners are herbivorous reptiles that generally don't cause trouble for people, but during mating season the males will en masse chase after the Princess Runner racing ahead of them to prove their speed and thus superiority, and the male that proves the fastest will become the King Runner who gets the mating rights.

Since Lizard Runners frequently cause a lot of disturbance and damage to settlements during their competitions as well as attack other animals that rival them in speed, quests are posted for adventurers to take out the Princess Runner so that the reptiles will stop racing. 

##Variations:
#Knee-kick Runner: A small but powerful breed of Lizard Runner that uses their amazing speed and destructive knee kick able to shatter boulders in order to hunt their prey. It's related with the Running Hawkites.
#Green Lizard Runner: Lizard Runners with green scales.
#Flashing Lizard Runner: Lizard Runners giving off a yellow glow that upon dashing, and will leave behind particles of light.

##Abilities:
#Speedy Running: Lizard Runners are fast enough to surpass the speed of galloping horses.
#Kick: The Lizard Runners' kick can break bones or worse.

entries.name: Monster: Cabbage
entries.content:
Cabbages are expensive vegetables that can fly at high speeds.

##Appearance: Cabbages look just like common cabbages except that they have eyes, and many flap their leaves when flying. The version in the manga have white eyes and flap the lower leaves, while the ones in the anime have black eyes and flap the upper leaves.

They look very similar to Lettuces, though the specific differences in appearance portrayed vary with the media. 

##Overview: Being magical creatures like many vegetables in the Parallel World, Cabbages fetch a high price because of their great flavor and texture, but once ripe will tear themselves out of the ground and fly towards distant lands across the sea so they will die without getting eaten. As such, during cabbage harvesting season when they flee from the cabbage farms en masse, the Adventurer Guild will pay adventurers to catch the Cabbages.

##Variations:
#Spring Cabbage: Cabbages of springtime that have a higher vitality, due to having survived the hard winter.
#Purple Cabbage: A purple Cabbage that is spawned in the secret super tribulation room of the Island in the Sky.
#Metal Cabbage: Cabbages made out of metal that fly around in Shangri-La and the Magic-Sealer Cave.
#Gold Cabbage: Rare Cabbages made out of gold that fly around in Shangri-La and the Bottomless Labyrinth.
#Brussels Sprouts: Smaller version of Cabbages that are not only faster, but have an instinct of bunching up to envelop enemy creatures in order to kill them through overheat or suffocation.

##Abilities: Flight: Cabbages can magically make themselves float and fly at high speeds, thus capable of injuring people standing in their escape path as they collide into them.

entries.name: Monster: Kobold
entries.content:
Kobolds are demi-humans that are synonymous with mooks.

##Appearance: Kobolds look like short bipedal dogs with humanoid clawed limbs, while other specific appearance traits vary depending on the media. 

##Overview: Kobolds are by themselves weaker than the regular human, and thus survive by living in nests as well as gathering in large numbers enough to overwhelm fledgling adventurers. They are generally armed with simple weaponry, though high-ranking individuals may have access to exotic armaments.

As they are frequently the targets of subjugation quests, many Kobolds living in the wild have a symbiotic relationship with the Beginner's Banes, in which the clever felines keep them safe from common threats so they can serve as bait to attract beginner adventurers.

While in general the structure of Kobold society is primitive, many of them find service in the armies of the Devil King, where there are ranks such Hero (which is troublesome even for intermediate adventurers) and Guard.

entries.name: Location: Arcanletia
entries.content:
Arcanletia is a city in Belzerg that serves as the patron city of the Goddess of Water Aqua and headquarters the Axis Order that worships her.

##Overview: Widely known as the City of Water and Hot Springs, Arcanletia is also the headquarters of the infamous Axis Order, who uses aggressive methods and scams to convert new followers. The sect is also responsible for the city's water control.

The Eris Order also has a small presence in the city, owning a church far smaller then that of the Axis Order's. The local Eris followers suffer from constant harassment at the hands of the Axis cultists, and their church is often vandalized, both particularly by a certain beautiful Axis priestess. They are also responsible for the main spring custody.

Apart from the cathedral, the city has another temple for worshiping Aqua, although it got submerged in the lake long ago and was forgotten, until the lake began splitting itself daily to reveal it when Kazuma and his party returned to Arcanletia in their search for the cursed relic's replacement parts.

##History: Although the city is the headquarters of the Axis Order, the sect had problems converting tourists to their church, due to their not-so-cleaver schemes. It changed when the Crimson Demon Megumin taught more cunning and aggressive methods to the Axis Order in exchange of a roof and food.

The city however suffered a series of incidents with their water supply, first when the Axis Order Pontiff Zesta accidentally mixed up the baking soda and the gelatinous slime mix while he was cleaning the distribution system.

entries.name: Location: Crimson Demon Village
entries.content:
The Crimson Demon Village is a location in the Kingdom of Belzerg where the Crimson Demons reside. 

##Overview: The village is home to the Crimson Demons and is the birthplace of Megumin and Yunyun. Located within a forest filled with dangerous monsters, people rarely travel there by foot, despite there being a well-trodden path leading to it, preferring magic methods such as Teleportation.

Due to being a rather small village, many residents have specialized tasks reminiscent of small communities pre-urbanization in both North American colonies and Europe during the 16th and 17th centuries. There is a tailor, baker, fisherman, a tapster, and even a fortune teller (world-specific), while some are unemployed.

Their community main economic activity is tourism, as several "tourist attractions" exist in and around the village, obtained by the inhabitants to allure people into sightseeing there. The names of these attractions, along with some local businesses, which, despite being alluring, are, in most cases, totally bogus, were given by "the most intelligent Crimson Demon" for attracting customers from outside the village.

The village is usually under successive attacks from the Devil King's Army and monsters, being constantly destroyed (sometimes by its own inhabitants). However, it is always easily rebuilt by the villagers using Earth Golems and summoned Demons.

##Tourist Attractions:
#Griffin Statue: A Griffin who wandered into the village and got petrified.
#Cat-Ears Shrine: A Japanese shrine for worshipping a girl figurine, which is a holy relic given by a traveler after the village ancestors saved him from monsters, though Kazuma identifies it as actually an action figure from a Japanese.
#Rock with a Sword in It: A holy sword said to give immense power to the one who pulls it out of a stone, though it is actually an ordinary sword with a spell cast on it, so that only the ten thousandth person could pull it out.
#Wishing Pond: According to the legend, someone can summon the Goddess of Silver and Gold by offering axes and coins, though, in fact, it's a source of blades and metal to the village blacksmith.
#Mysterious Massive Facility: The research facility where the Crimson Demons were created by the Head Researcher.
#Underground Storehouse: The subterranean storage adjacent to the facility, where the "Mage-Killer" and many other old creations of the Head Researcher were sealed.
#Tomb of the Dark God: The place where Wolbach was sealed.
#Land Where the Nameless Goddess Was Sealed: The place where Regina was sealed.
#Demon's Hill: A hill on the edge of the village, where legends says that couples who confess their love there will be cursed by the resident Demon God and cannot break up.
#Monster Museum: A museum where the tribe displays trophies from monsters.
#All-Overseeing Observatory "Vanirmild": A observation platform on the top of a hill, used for spying on the Devil King's Daughter's room.
#Mixed Bath: A dynamic huge bath where the owner used Create Water and Fireball to make hot water. It isn't a real mixed bath.

##Villager Sites:
#Megumin's Home: A ramshackle lodge where Megumin and her family live, which also serves as her father's workshop. Her parents later took out a loan to upscale it into a fashionable house.
#Bukkororii's Home: The home of Bukkororii and his family, which is situated close to Megumin's.
#Village Chief's Home: The home of Yunyun and her family.
#Huts: The area where most of the inhabitants reside.
#Red Prison: The school where students study magic as well as various skills and knowledge.
#Business District: The area where most of the businesses are located. Stores include cafes, restaurants, clothing shop, shoe shop, weapons shop, potions shop, etc.
#Bar Succubus Lingerie: The only pub in the Crimson Demon Village. It's also isn't a real lingerie bar.
#Deadly Poison Café: The village's only café, owned by Torosuke.
#Goblin Slayer: The village's only armor shop.
#Agricultural Zone: The area allocated for agriculture, where inhabitants use magic to swiftly farm crops.
#Mutual MP Support Facility: The area where most of the village's industrial production is located.
#Decayed Fort: A fort constructed for warring against the Devil King's armies, but was abandoned after the inhabitants proved they can fight without it.

##Trivia:
#The village is the only place in the country that has an implemented school system.
#The fact that the research facility was marked as belonging to the Kingdom of Noise hints that the village used to be part of the now-destroyed kingdom's territory.

entries.name: Species: Crimson Demons
entries.content:
The Crimson Demons is a tribe of mages that lives in the Crimson Demon Village.

##Appearance: The most defining physical traits of every member of the Crimson Demons are their brunette or black hair, pale skin and red eyes, the latter of which will glow vibrantly when they're excited.

They are also born with a bar code tattoo in a random place of their body (Yunyun's is in her inner thigh while Megumin's is at her buttock) as a result of being artificially-modified humans.

The Crimson Demon women are also renowned by their beauty, and most of them are well-endowed. 

##Personality:
They're all chūnibyō, hence their weird names and demeanor. The Crimson Demons usually act a very melodramatic and eccentric way, and are fantasy-prones. They are impetuous too, as well as obsessed by "coolness", which is combined with delusions of grandeur, as they often declare themselves the "foremost" of something of their tribe. Crimson Demons are also attention seekers.

They also commonly strike cringe worthy poses or have catchphrases and self-introductions. For them, a signature pose and phrase is extremely important, as the latter is like a dying last words or the quote of a lifetime. Like most chūni people, many Crimson Demons are also NEETs, not working or just working enough to live. According to Kazuma, if they weren't NEETs, they could have already taken over the world.

##History:
The Crimson Demons were created by the same creator who made the Destroyer. In light of the high demand for enhancement surgeries in the Kingdom of Noise, an improvement coupon to become a Crimson Demons were given as a prize in a gachapon machine in the Research Laboratory along with the prototype Playscation and Game Girl Color, in order to select the subjects. The surgery was a resounding success and the resulting new race had an extremely high Intelligence and Magical Power.

In regards to their chūnibyō tendencies, the people who were selected to undergo the operation all had this characteristic by complete happenstance. This resulted in their red eyes, strange names, and a tribe name, all a request by them to their benefactor.

##Culture:
Children begin attending the village's school at 12 and are only considered adults when they gain the necessary 30 skill points to learn Advanced Magic, which represents their adulthood. Otherwise, a Crimson Demon who doesn't know Advanced Magic is considered immature and a joke.[6]

To this extent, skill-up potions are handed out as rewards for academic achievements, which means demonstrating knowledge in chūnibyō-esque behavior or magic, both core tenets of Crimson Demons society. The other way skill points are gained is by farming levels, where the teacher of the class freezes the various dangerous monsters in the forest surrounding the village and the students kill them as they are subdued.

Children are expected to either become adventurers or succeed their parents in whatever job the latter performs. Similar to their other attributes resulting from chūnibyō-ness, they all claim to be the "foremost (job) in the village," or that they hail from the "number one (store) in the village," both of which are technically true as they are the only ones who do these jobs in the area.

Once a Crimson Demon reaches their old-age, they depart from the village in a journey in order to find and fight a stronger adversary, so they can have a "heroic death", having their names written in their "Chronicles of the Crimson Demons". Otherwise, the elder will be considered a coward.

##Traditions:
#The tribe has a custom of creating protective charms stuffed with the hairs of people possessing strong magical powers, which when placed into luggage can scare away thieves who find it gross, and in the case the luggage is lost will freak out any passerby who discover it so much they quickly take it to the police station.
#This custom appears to have developed from another one used for love charms, which involves placing the hair of the admired person inside a straw doll and nailing into a tree while praying at night in a parody of its original Japanese practice, making that person feel the "pang of love" in their heart whenever he/she lays eyes on the charm practitioner.
#The cabals of Crimson Demons from outside their village usually have gatherings to realize "important duties". Megumin and Yunyun, as parts of one such group, frequently reunite for coolest pose or signature phrase showdowns.
#Quadrennially, the Crimson Demons teleport to the Devil King's Castle surrounding, attacking the barrier while they realize a barbecue, teleporting away before the army reach them.
#During the Supermoon, the Crimson Demons have a moonwatching tradition, which involves eating a rabbit hot pot, followed by howling at the moon.
#The next Village Chief must undertake a trial with three challenges: A riddle challenge, which was replaced by striking cringe worthy poses after Megumin destroyed the riddle items; a luck challenge, which the contestants must choose the right door; and survive one night in the forest by themselves. A contestant can undertake the trial three times alongside a partner, who doesn't need to be a Crimson Demon.

##Abilities:Crimson Demons were made to be exceptional spell casters. For such reason, their bodies were modified so that they have an astonishing magic potential.

#Great Magical Power: Crimson Demons possess a high mana reserve. Aside from that, they are all able to use Advanced Magic from a very young age. A prodigy like Megumin can even cast Explosion, the highest class destruction spell which requires a insane amount of MP to be activated. Because of their Magical Power, they usually work crafting magic items or potions.
#Genius: Another key stat for mage classes, the Crimson Demons also possess high Intelligence. Crimson Demons are able to memorize the lengthy required enchantments for many high-level spells, for which they have a natural aptitude. They are also very creative, perceptive, and cunning.

##Equipment: Robes: Clothes designed by the Crimson Demons' creator that are highly resistant and comfortable during summer and winter. However, when they take some magic damage, the women's robes will expose their panties for a moment while men's have a tiny chance of exploding.

##Trivia:
#Alongside having strange first names, Crimson Demons seem to lack last names at all.
#Crimson Demons farmers are some of the most powerful mages in the community because of the nigh-daily combat they face subjugating their crops.
#Since the tribe is so much smaller than the internet-connected Japan, their chūnibyō poetry is vastly inferior to Kazuma's, even though Kazuma hasn't been a chūnibyō since before he reincarnated.
#Although being renowned as having many beauties, most of them are single and desperate for contact with men from the outside world, as not many people ever make it as far as the town.
#It is hard to describe if Crimson Demons are humans or not, but they can be considered as "beyond mere humans".

entries.name: Location: Red Prison
entries.content:
Red Prison is the only school in the Crimson Demon Village.

##Information: As an academy that enrolls into gender-specific classes young Crimson Demons who have not yet learned magic, students will be taught all sorts of magical knowledge and combat skills while getting supplied with potions to level up their skill points so they can learn advanced magic. Once a student learns any type of magic, they will graduate and be considered an independent archwizard.

Since the school issues each of its students an Adventurer Card upon enrollment, when they head to the Adventurer Guilds for signing up as adventurers after graduation, the process only entails having their cards and stats verified, while the registration fee as well as the steps involving a scan by a card-generating magic item can be skipped.

entries.name: Char: Megumin
entries.content:
{{char}} = Megumin. Megumin is an Arch Wizard of the Crimson Demons in the Parallel World,

##Appearance: Megumin is a young girl with shoulder-length brunette hair and oddly languid crimson-colored eyes. She has fair skin, doll-like features (being a Lolita type) and a light complexion. Like many Evil Eye Chūnibyō characters, Megumin wears a eye patch to "seal her power" and bandages in her right leg.

Megumin wears a classical witch attire such as a black cloak, a red robe, orange boots and a black wizard's hat, all with gold border and trimmings, alongside black choker, belt, a black stocking in the left leg and fingerless gloves. She carries a brown staff with a floating blue gem throughout her spinoff and until the 4th episode of the first season, where it turns red. 

##Personality: Megumin's most defining trait is her obsession for Explosion Magic. After being saved by a mysterious stranger using that spell, Megumin instantly fell in love with the Explosion Magic's unparalleled destructive power,[2] as well as its heat, the shock wave sensation over the body, smoke and glow,[3] reason why she dedicated years of her life studying and saving points in order to master the spell, while ignoring its many demerits.

After learning the Explosion Magic, Megumin started to come up with excuses to use it every day, both in quests or during her daily routine, recklessly using the spell at the first opportunity, sometimes just to show herself, relieve stress or gain XP, no matter how many problems she causes, although Megumin may grow anxious in delicate situations. While she gets excited about someone else joining her in the "Path of Explosion",[4] Megumin rejects any type of explosion that isn't Explosion Magic, such as Kazuma's tinymites.[5]

Like most Crimson Demons, Megumin has a chūnibyō personality, being into speeches in old Japanese dialect[6] and cringe-worthy poses,[7] although her act falls flat easily. She is also an attention seeker with delusions of grandeur, calling herself "the foremost arch wizard and wielder of Explosion Magic" and boasting of her genius and talent. Megumin has a taste for strange names, edge stuff and destructive hobbies too, as well as cute pets, but she doesn't admit it to keep up her "cool" pose.

Although Megumin is, according to Kazuma, weirdly smart[8] and has the most common sense of her party,[9] when it comes to her, she is quite childish, since Megumin is short-tempered, often rising to provocations and even threatening to explode the houses of those who enrage her. Meanwhile, regarding her loved ones, she is surprisingly mature, as while Megumin may be harsh with the ones she cares about, like Kazuma and Yunyun, Megumin is also exceptionally assertive and even empathetic.

Moreover, Megumin is very competitive, even having a notebook to count her wins against Yunyun. It is very common that Megumin tries to assert her dominance over her friends, whatever in competitions, play and even in her love life, using her relationship with Kazuma to make them envy. Megumin is also a cheater who does whatever it takes to win, no matter how brute, reason why she was considered a "ruffian" in her school.

Although Megumin is already old enough to get married in the Parallel World, she is still treated like a kid due to her underdeveloped appearance, which Megumin dislikes, as well as being called "loli" or "jailbait". She often tries to act like a mature woman, like trying to drink alcohol and flirting by sending mixed signals, because Megumin thinks that is the adult way of courting. She also has adult interests, like starting a family.

Megumin is very self-conscious about her preadolescent body. She often has the excuse that her body will develop later, although her bad nutrition and genetics say otherwise. Megumin is also very jealous of her friends' more developed bodies, even slapping their bosom in a fit of rage. She is obsessed about having a stunning body too, getting interested in becoming a great spell-caster because she believes that if she becomes a great wizard, she would have "a huge rack".

Due to her family being very poor, Megumin learned to get by herself early. She believes in the survival of the fittest, being merciless with monsters, even baby or cute ones, and used to hunt and steal her own food, eating even food remains, such as crusts of bread, and insects.[14] Megumin is also willing to use any underhanded method to survive, like stealing Yunyun's lunches at their duels in order to feed[2] and seizing the moment to blackmail Kazuma so she could join his party.

##Abilities: As a Crimson Demon prodigy, Megumin has an amazing Magic Potential, being able to make complex potions, craft magic items, and even reformulate the Explosion Magic chant in order to enhance its power. She also has the highest Intelligence of her party and just loses in Magical Power for Aqua.[19] However, while Megumin could even surpass Yunyun as an Arch Wizard,[20] she chose to specialize in Explosion Magic, the most powerful spell in the Detonation Series, instead, and thanks to its many demerits, such as becoming unable to control her mana emission, as well as her insistence in spending all her Skill Points increasing her spell destructive power instead of learning any other magic spell, she suffers from being too specialized, as while Megumin is an effective nuker, she is also an one-and-done glass cannon.

#Explosion Magic: A special branch magic of the Detonation Series that allows the user to summon a single beam of light, that detonates at the target, creating a devastating blast of pure magical power. It is the most powerful magic spell, learned by immortal beings like undead and gods, with enough spare skill points to learn it. Although the spell can damage ghosts, spirits, gods and demons, it has several demerits: it consumes too much MP, being a single shot spell (in Megumin's case, she always collapses since the spell also consumes her HP); the magic is also so powerful it also affects the surrounding landscape, being dangerous to use it in dungeons, that can collapse over the user; lastly, its noise attracts all the monsters in the surrounding area.
#Skills: Besides magic, Megumin devotes all of her Skill Points into skills in order to improve the power of her spell, instead of use them to increase her MP:
#Explosion Magic Increase: Increases the power of Blasting, Detonation and Explosion Magics.
#High-Speed Incantation: Decreases the time of incantation.
